verdict.rationale: LocalAI's built-in web chat and agent platform, plus the `local-ai chat` shell agent, can read your files and pull live data through external MCP servers. That lets you ask a model for insights and suggestions about your data inside the product. However, this is general-purpose chat and agent tooling you must set up yourself, not a dedicated insights or suggestions feature. Missing for 10: purpose-built proactive insights/suggestions over user data, documentation of data-analysis workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
